description:
Activate Verdant Eidolon for {G}, sacrificing itself and adding {G}{G}{G}.
Resolve The Cauldron of Eternity's trigger first, putting Verdant Eidolon on the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, returning Verdant Eidolon to the battlefield.
Repeat.
Once you have achieved infinite green mana, you can repeat the combo adding other colors of mana with Verdant Eidolon for infinite mana of any color.
